items.title: Mike Johnson asks Trump for more midterm money as Republicans seek to avert disaster in House races
items.brief: In the final sprint to the midterms, Speaker Mike Johnson went to President Donald Trump with a crucial ask, according to a person familiar with the exchange.

items.title: Man who fatally struck deputy after his son was killed by Cincinnati police is convicted of murder
items.brief: Cincinnati, Ohio (AP) — A man who struck and killed a county deputy with his car the day after his teenage son was fatally shot by a Cincinnati police officer was convicted of murder Friday.

items.title: Melania Trump says she secured one-city ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine for humanitarian aid
items.brief: First lady Melania Trump announced on Friday that she helped secure a localized ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the city of Oleshky to facilitate the humane evacuation of elderly residents.

items.title: US discreetly moves diplomats and families from multiple Middle Eastern countries as escalation fears grow
items.brief: The United States is rushing to move some diplomats and their family members from posts in the Middle East as the threat of regional escalation looms, according to multiple sources familiar with the matter.

items.title: Defense lawyers in Charlie Kirk’s killing want a 2029 trial. Kirk’s widow calls that ‘out of line’
items.brief: A ruling on the trial date for the man charged with killing conservative activist Charlie Kirk will come next month, a Utah judge declared Friday.

items.title: ‘The most complicated launch campaign ever’: NASA lays out mad dash to test lunar landers
items.brief: NASA offered new details Friday about a mad dash to get two lunar landers — built by competing companies Blue Origin and SpaceX — and the space agency’s own rocket and spacecraft ready for a crucial test mission next…

items.title: At least 7 people killed in unprecedented shooting at church in Jordan
items.brief: At least seven people were killed and another 40 injured after gunmen opened fire on a church in Jordan’s southern Karak province, in an unprecedented attack that has left the nation stunned.

items.title: Jury convicts man of rape, murder 14 years after UNC-Chapel Hill student’s death
items.brief: A man accused of killing a North Carolina college student 14 years ago was convicted Friday of first-degree murder, rape and other charges after prosecutors told jurors that forensic evidence was “screaming his name.”
